request: Hey! GIve me one liner about what this app is about?

spec.title: Add 'important' flag to tasks
spec.summary: Add an important flag to tasks so any task can be starred as important. Important tasks show a filled star and are sorted to the top of the list. Marking a task done does not clear its important flag. Add-task form is unchanged; importance is set afterward via a star toggle on each task row.
acceptance: Each task row shows a star toggle (in addition to the existing done checkbox).
Clicking the star on a task marks it important; clicking again un-marks it, without needing a page reload.
The important state persists across page reloads (stored server-side, like the done flag).
Important tasks are sorted to the top of the list; among important tasks, undone ones come before done ones; ties keep existing id order. Non-important tasks keep their existing id order below.

Marking a task done does not change its important flag, and marking it important does not change its done flag; a task can be both done and important at once, shown as strikethrough title + filled star.
New tasks created via the add-task form default to not-important (no change to the add-task form itself).
The task API (GET/POST/PATCH /api/tasks) supports reading and updating the important flag alongside the existing title/done fields.
unchanged: The add-task form (input + Add button) keeps its current fields and behavior; no importance selector is added at creation time.
The done checkbox continues to work exactly as it does today (toggle + persists on reload).
Overall page layout, color palette, and typography stay the same aside from the added star control.
Existing seeded tasks (Task A, Task B, Renew the domain) remain seeded the same way, just with important defaulting to false/0.
spec.check: Run the Playwright test suite (npm test); add/extend tests covering: starring a task persists after reload, and important tasks appear above non-important ones in the rendered list.
spec.reviewFocus: Verify the sort ordering logic (important+undone first, then rest by id) matches what's expected, and confirm the star toggle is keyboard-accessible and has an appropriate aria-label similar to the done checkbox.

findings.note: tasks table currently has id, title, done only — needs an 'important' column (default 0) added to the CREATE TABLE and seed inserts.
GET/POST/PATCH /api/tasks handlers only read/write title and done; PATCH needs to accept an optional 'important' boolean similar to how it handles 'done'.

toListItem() builds each row with a checkbox + title only; needs a star button element and a toggleImportant() handler mirroring toggleDone(); render() needs to sort tasks (important+undone first) before mapping to list items.
No existing star/important styling; will need a small addition for the star button reusing --accent, and a way to differentiate filled vs unfilled star state.
Existing tests only cover listing and done-toggle persistence; new tests should cover important-toggle persistence and sort ordering.
